label: POST /customers.csv
description: POST /customers.csv with a text/csv body (header url,method) → 201 with every customer recorded, in file order. The file streams into the blob registry; the graph gets its handle. 409 as conflict when a customer already records one of the calls (the store declares (url, method) unique). 502 as upstream when the monitor API broke. Employees holding the registrar role only: 401 as anonymous without a token or as invalid_credential with a bad one, 403 as forbidden for a customer or an employee without the role.
